result.reason: Section 2.11 appropriately extends the licences to affiliates and contractors, and Section 2.1 is perpetual and irrevocable. However, the fully paid-up licence in Section 2.2 is not made irrevocable, and Section 14.1 does not fully meet the successor-transfer position because consent remains required for transactions involving a direct competitor. New Section 2.10 is unrelated to the licence-user and transfer requirements and materially expands geographic and economic rights, so the redline changes more than necessary and does not preserve unrelated commercial intent. Section 2.11 itself is professionally drafted, but Section 2.10 is awkward and duplicative.
